questions.question: Which policy is refreshed for the next rollout batch?
options: The behavior policy follows the current policy; the reference policy remains frozen.
Both the behavior policy and the reference policy update after every inner PPO gradient step.
The reference policy refreshes each rollout while old behavior probabilities remain fixed for the entire run.
questions.explanation: Behavior identity belongs to the collected data. Reference identity belongs to the regularized objective.
optionFeedback: Behavior identity belongs to the collected data. Reference identity belongs to the regularized objective.
Behavior probabilities stay fixed within the collected rollout’s update epochs. The candidate policy changes; the reference remains frozen.
Keeping the old behavior forever makes later rollout ratios describe the wrong collection policy. Refresh behavior data for each new rollout.
